adjustment.method: ridge-regularised offense/defense/home-field effects per metric, fitted on every completed game before the data cutoff; opponent-adjusted values are what a team would do against an average opponent

epa.reason: Expected points added requires play-level expected-points values from a licensed feed (CollegeFootballData needs an API key and its host is not reachable from the collection environment). ESPN's keyless play log carries down, distance and yard line but no EPA. Opponent-adjusted SUCCESS RATE (and explosive rate, points per drive, points per scoring opportunity) are the efficiency measures provided; none is renamed EPA.
